from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from pomodoro.gui.main_window import MainWindow
from pomodoro.core.timer import Phase
qa = QApplication([])
w = MainWindow(Path('/workspace/sounds')); w.show()
tv = w.timer_view
store = tv.history
# tiny focus so round completes fast
tv.focus_spin.setValue(tv.focus_spin.minimum() if tv.focus_spin.minimum()>0 else 1)
print("focus_spin value:", tv.focus_spin.value())
# directly manipulate engine config to 1 second focus for test
from pomodoro.core.timer import TimerConfig
cfg = TimerConfig(focus_minutes=1/60, break_minutes=1/60, rounds=2, long_break_enabled=False, long_break_interval=2)
tv.engine.apply_config(cfg); tv.engine.start()
print("state:", tv.engine.state, "phase:", tv.engine.phase)
# tick until focus completes
tv.engine.tick(61)
print("after tick state:", tv.engine.state, "phase:", tv.engine.phase)
# now abort next focus: ensure we are in focus? after focus -> break
tv.engine.tick(61)  # break completes -> focus round 2
print("now phase:", tv.engine.phase, "round:", tv.engine.round_number)
tv.engine.start(); tv.engine.tick(30)   # half of 60s focus
print("remaining:", tv.engine.remaining_seconds)
tv._on_stop_clicked()
import sqlite3
print("DB rows:", list(sqlite3.connect('/tmp/pomo_e2e3/pomodoro.db').execute("select duration_minutes, completed from focus_sessions")))
QTimer.singleShot(200, qa.quit); qa.exec()
